decision_points.question: Should AB jump directly to RL or automatic policy mutation?
decision_points.decision: No. Close the trajectory/outcome/reflection/retrieval loop through read-only reports and fixtures first.
decision_points.reason: Feedback density and behavior-lift evidence are not yet strong enough for automatic influence.

decision_points.question: Should the first report become a new MCP surface immediately?
decision_points.decision: No. Land a CLI/script-style read-only report first; consider MCP only after repeated use proves the surface is worth exposing.
decision_points.reason: This avoids expanding the tool surface before there is demonstrated repeated value.

decision_points.question: Should full cargo fmt --check block this slice?
decision_points.decision: No. Use scoped rustfmt for touched files because full repo formatting currently reports unrelated historical diffs and rustfmt OOMed while rendering a huge diff.
decision_points.reason: A whole-repo formatting cleanup is a separate lane and should not be mixed into this workflow-feedback slice.

outcome.behavior_change: AB now has a repeatable read-only CLI for workflow-feedback maturity reporting and Experience Object v0 fixture emission.
evidence: CLI command agent-bridge workflow-feedback-report landed in commit 4d622e3
live CLI smoke emitted schema agent_bridge.workflow_feedback_report.v0
CLI output kept writes_memory=false, changes_retrieval_order=false, runtime_influence_allowed=false
ab-bridge all-target check passed with existing warnings only
memory and forum anchors were synchronized
known_limits: The emitted fixture is a scaffold unless manually reviewed against a completed AB lane.
The scorecard is heuristic and descriptive, not a causal behavior-lift metric.
The CLI reads current store statistics; counts drift as new memories and tool calls are recorded.

reflection.lesson: AB's self-improvement loop should mature from research to read-only report to fixture before any default influence. The system can observe work well enough to score maturity, but feedback density and behavior-lift evidence must improve before optimization is trusted.
reusable_workflow: land research in docs, memory, and board
measure current state with read-only telemetry
write a report with boundaries and falsifiers
turn the report into a repeatable read-only CLI
verify tests, live smoke, build/check, and scoped formatting
promote only manually reviewed fixtures toward shadow scoring
reflection.falsifier: If repeated workflow-feedback reports do not produce adopted improvements or measurable behavior lift, keep the CLI as an audit tool and redesign the feedback loop before adding influence.

promotion.suggested_trigger: When planning AB workflow-feedback measurement, Experience Object fixtures, or self-improvement policy gates.
